mapper.sql: SELECT transaction.transaction_id, transaction_type.code AS transaction_type, transaction.parent_transaction_id, transaction.account_id, transaction.reference, currency.currency_code, transaction.quantity, transaction.created_ts FROM transaction JOIN transaction_type ON transaction_type.transaction_type_id = transaction.transaction_type_id JOIN currency ON currency.currency_id = transaction.currency_id
mapper.select: WITH stored AS ( INSERT INTO transaction (transaction_type_id, parent_transaction_id, account_id, reference, quantity, currency_id, created_ts) VALUES ((SELECT transaction_type_id FROM transaction_type WHERE code = #{transactionType}), #{parentTransactionId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{accountId}, #{reference}, #{amount}, (SELECT currency_id FROM currency WHERE currency_code = #{currencyCode}), now()) ON CONFLICT (reference) DO NOTHING RETURNING transaction_id, transaction_type_id, parent_transaction_id, account_id, reference, quantity, currency_id, created_ts ) SELECT stored.transaction_id, transaction_type.code AS transaction_type, stored.parent_transaction_id, stored.account_id, stored.reference, currency.currency_code, stored.quantity, stored.created_ts FROM stored JOIN transaction_type ON transaction_type.transaction_type_id = stored.transaction_type_id JOIN currency ON currency.currency_id = stored.currency_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_detail (transaction_id, transaction_type_id, shopper_country_id, shopper_country_subdivision_id, psp_account_id, net_quantity, tax_quantity) VALUES (#{transactionId}, (SELECT transaction_type_id FROM transaction_type WHERE code = 'PAYMENT'), (SELECT country_id FROM country WHERE iso_code = #{shopperCountry}), (SELECT subdivision.country_subdivision_id FROM country_subdivision subdivision JOIN country ON country.country_id = subdivision.country_id WHERE country.iso_code = #{shopperCountry} AND subdivision.code = #{shopperCountrySubdivision,jdbcType=VARCHAR}), #{pspAccountId}, #{netAmount}, #{taxAmount})
mapper.sql: SELECT payment.transaction_id, payment.account_id, payment.reference, currency.currency_code, payment.quantity, payment.created_ts, country.iso_code AS shopper_country, subdivision.code AS shopper_country_subdivision, detail.psp_account_id, detail.net_quantity, detail.tax_quantity FROM transaction payment JOIN payment_detail detail ON detail.transaction_id = payment.transaction_id JOIN currency ON currency.currency_id = payment.currency_id JOIN country ON country.country_id = detail.shopper_country_id LEFT JOIN country_subdivision subdivision ON subdivision.country_subdivision_id = detail.shopper_country_subdivision_id WHERE payment.reference = #{reference}
mapper.select: SELECT event.transaction_event_id, event_type.code AS transaction_event_type, event.event_ts FROM transaction_event event JOIN transaction_event_type event_type ON event_type.transaction_event_type_id = event.transaction_event_type_id WHERE event.transaction_id = #{transactionId} ORDER BY event.transaction_event_id

WITH stored AS ( INSERT INTO transaction_event (transaction_id, transaction_event_type_id, event_ts) VALUES (#{transactionId}, (SELECT transaction_event_type_id FROM transaction_event_type WHERE code = #{transactionEventType}), now()) ON CONFLICT (transaction_id, transaction_event_type_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING transaction_event_id, transaction_event_type_id, event_ts ) SELECT stored.transaction_event_id, event_type.code AS transaction_event_type, stored.event_ts FROM stored JOIN transaction_event_type event_type ON event_type.transaction_event_type_id = stored.transaction_event_type_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refund_detail (transaction_id, transaction_type_id, net_quantity, tax_quantity) VALUES (#{transactionId}, (SELECT transaction_type_id FROM transaction_type WHERE code = 'REFUND'), #{netAmount}, #{taxAmount})
mapper.sql: SELECT refund.transaction_id, refund.parent_transaction_id, refund.account_id, refund.reference, currency.currency_code, refund.quantity, refund.created_ts, detail.net_quantity, detail.tax_quantity FROM transaction refund JOIN refund_detail detail ON detail.transaction_id = refund.transaction_id JOIN currency ON currency.currency_id = refund.currency_id
